FIELDS.NAME: Variety Mart Plus
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Variety Mart Plus operates as a retail store offering a diverse range of consumer goods, including household items, clothing, toys, and personal care products. Our core operations focus on providing a wide selection of new merchandise to customers in a welcoming and accessible environment. With an emphasis on inventory management and loss prevention, we maintain thorough documentation of our stock and conduct regular audits to minimize shrinkage and enhance operational efficiency. Our store is conveniently located in a high-traffic area and is designed with adequate security measures, including surveillance systems and secure storage areas. We prioritize training our staff in customer service and emergency procedures to ensure a positive shopping experience while also safeguarding against potential risks. Our commitment to compliance with all relevant local, state, and federal regulations reflects our dedication to ethical business practices. By fostering strong vendor relationships with reputable and licensed suppliers, we ensure the quality and safety of our products. We also actively engage with the community through local marketing initiatives to drive foot traffic and create a sense of community connection. Overall, our operations are structured to deliver a reliable and enjoyable shopping experience while mitigating risks associated with retail activities.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not exceed $1 million in annual gross sales and confirms that exceptional inventory and loss prevention controls are in place. Additionally, online sales comprise less than 90% of total sales, and robust cybersecurity and fraud prevention measures are implemented. Furthermore, repair or offsite service operations remain below 40% of total business activities, and the sale of firearms, ammunition, tobacco, vaping products, or other regulated items is strictly prohibited.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a theft incident occurred resulting in a loss of $2,000. The stolen goods were primarily household items and toys. The loss has been reported to the local authorities, and we are currently following up with our insurance to process the claim. On 08/10/2023, we experienced minor water damage from a plumbing issue that caused an estimated loss of $1,500. Repairs are underway, and we've secured the area to prevent further damage.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Secured with UL Class 350, Grade 1 Safe, Label 1.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security guards and alarm monitoring services.

FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Variety Mart Plus does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retailing a diverse range of consumer goods without involving hazardous materials.
